user.description: Pick the service to add. Every service is independent — add only the ones you run.

sonarr.title: Sonarr
sonarr.description: Address and API key of your Sonarr instance. The key is in Settings → General.

data_description.url: Base address of the service with protocol, host and port; the suggestion in the field already carries the default port.
data_description.api_key: The key from the service's own settings page; it is tried once before the entry is created.
data_description.verify_ssl: Checks the TLS certificate on https addresses; switch it off only for a self-signed certificate, default on.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between two queries to the service; default 60 seconds, allowed 15 to 3600.
